reviews.title: Best fan brand around, period.
reviews.comment: These things MOVE air, incredible performance. Installed 6 in my NZXT H9 Flow and it keeps everything right where I want it. When they get above 50% pwm the noise gets more pronounced, but even at load they're never moving above 30-45%. You won't find better argb performance anywhere than from Arctic. The colors from the ARGB are solid.
reviews.author: Colton Rodgers

reviews.title: High quality and budget friendly
reviews.comment: Great bundle for bottom intake setups. Great cooling ability, high fan speeds and quality typical of Arctic. Highly recommended
reviews.author: Justin Sievers

reviews.title: Great
reviews.comment: Great fans. Airflow is insane. Lights are very bright. But screwing in the screws to unthreaded plastic is VERY DIFFICULT.
reviews.author: effie

reviews.title: Flashy lights, spinney spinner fan things.
reviews.comment: They make air move and look super cool. Win! The options are all standard so not going to spout words you dont need. Really nice fans. move air when needed, Pwm slows them when not. 100% functional. TY
reviews.author: Mr Frosty

reviews.title: Worth every dollar
reviews.comment: These fans really cool the air flow is awesome. Yes they are a little loud when they cranked up to full speed but keep in mind how often are you going to hear them full blast after some adjustments. The RGB is very bright I turn mine down to low and they are perfect for my build and MSI fan controller works very well with them.
reviews.author: Jessica
